title: Hot or Not Built the Internet We’re Still Swiping Through
summary: Before the internet learned to like, match, and swipe, it learned to ask one brutally simple question: hot or not? Twenty-six years later, the dating industry appears to be retreating from the internet Hot or Not helped create.
